issues.detail: The Greek verb 'ουκ ευδοκησας' (ouk eudokēsas) is in the 2nd person singular, meaning 'You did not please/approve.' The Vietnamese translation 'Ngài chẳng đẹp lòng' uses the 3rd person pronoun 'Ngài' (He/Him), which changes the intended audience from a direct address to a third-person statement.
